NARRATIVE_DARK_21_INTRO_4: {SHOUT:crazydave}We were back in the present and there were weird portals EVERYWHERE!

NARRATIVE_DARK_22_INTRO_16: {EXCITED:crazydave}I knew my sun senses haven't failed!

NARRATIVE_DARK_22_INTRO_3: {EXCITED:crazydave}Yeah, I smell it too. I smell sun theft!

NARRATIVE_DARK_22_INTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}Actually, my scanners are picking something up.
NARRATIVE_DARK_24_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}My camera footage shows two sneaky zombie bandits stole them earlier in the night.

NARRATIVE_DARK_24_INTRO_6: {EXCITED:crazydave}The only good thing about night is that I can scare people from the fog!
NARRATIVE_DARK_24_INTRO_7: {SAY:crazydave}But there isn't even any fog here!
NARRATIVE_DARK_25_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Penny, what is that group of masked zombies with hammers doing here?
NARRATIVE_DARK_25_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, I regret to inform you that Dr. Edgar George Zomboss has written an execution warrant for you.
NARRATIVE_DARK_25_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}Executioners from all over the zombie kingdom have arrived.
NARRATIVE_DARK_25_INTRO_6: {SAY:crazydave}Well, at least we have our lawnmo-
NARRATIVE_DARK_26_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, there appears to be yet another new zombie here.
NARRATIVE_DARK_26_INTRO_10: {EXCITED:crazydave}On to adventure! We must rescue Witch Hazel!
NARRATIVE_DARK_26_INTRO_11: {TIRED:winnie}Normal settings, can I switch back to, Sir Dave?
NARRATIVE_DARK_26_INTRO_2: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Call me Sir Dave! For I sir the most anyone has sir'd!
NARRATIVE_DARK_26_INTRO_3: {TIRED:winnie}Sir Dave, this zombie seems to be a dark sorcerer.
NARRATIVE_DARK_27_INTRO_2: {TIRED:winnie}Turn zombies into Puff-shrooms, Witch Hazel can.
NARRATIVE_DARK_27_INTRO_3: {TIRED:winnie}Clearing out tough zombies, she is useful for.
NARRATIVE_DARK_27_INTRO_4: {TIRED:winnie}In big groups of zombies, less effective she is.
NARRATIVE_DARK_27_INTRO_6: {TIRED:crazydave}I... couldn't understand a single thing you said.
NARRATIVE_DARK_27_INTRO_7: {TIRED:winnie}Normal settings, can I switch back to, Sir Dave?
NARRATIVE_DARK_27_INTRO_9: {TIRED:winnie}Please never do that again, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_DARK_30_INTRO_2: {SAY:zombossicon}Or shalt I sayeth, wrongdoers of the Zombot kind.
NARRATIVE_DARK_30_INTRO_3: {SAY:zombossicon}Thy souls art wretch'd from thy destructions of my priz'd inventions!
NARRATIVE_DARK_30_INTRO_4: {SAY:zombossicon}Thee distemperate daws, thy reckoning hast cometh!
NARRATIVE_DARK_30_INTRO_5: {SAY:zombossicon}Sayeth goodbye to thy days of planth throttlething.
NARRATIVE_DARK_30_INTRO_6: {SAY:zombossicon}F'r, if't be true mine own improved dragon succeeds in thy demise, I shalt f'rev'r beest vict'rious!
NARRATIVE_DARK_30_OUTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Gah! The p'rfect dragon hast did fail!
NARRATIVE_DARK_30_OUTRO_2: {SAY:zombossicon}This timeth, I has't actually did place mine own desires into this attempteth!
NARRATIVE_DARK_30_OUTRO_3: {SAY:zombossicon}Nay w'rries, mine own grand researcheth is still progressing in a manner smooth, so thy doings art of nay consequences.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_EVILPOTIONS_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}Warning! I've detected carafes containing chemical compounds of a malevolent makeup!
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_EVILPOTIONS_2: {TIRED:crazydave}Can you translate that into Crazy Dave Talk for me?
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_EVILPOTIONS_3: {TIRED:winnie}There are evil potions on the lawn!
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_EVILPOTIONS_4: {EXCITED:crazydave}Evil medieval potions! They're the most dangerous kind...
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_EVILPOTIONS_5: {EXCITED:crazydave}On account of having twice the evil!
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_2: {TIRED:winnie}No one, User Dave. We have simply arrived in the Dark Ages.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_4: {PLAYFUL:winnie}Indeed. According to my research, a plague has swept this era.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_5: {SAY:winnie}Also, sun no longer falls from the sky.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_6: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}What we need is someone to brighten this place up!
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_8: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}These guys not only know how to turn a frown upside down...
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_FIRSTLEVEL_9: {EXCITED:crazydave}They make more sun as they grow! Great guys, very talented.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_FUMESHROOM_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:crazydave}I'm afraid the Dark Ages are giving me a bad case of the vapours.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_FUMESHROOM_2: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, the vapours are no longer considered a real ailment.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_FUMESHROOM_3: {SAY:winnie}But I believe Fume-shroom will be of use here.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_FUMESHROOM_4: {EXCITED:winnie}His vapors are quite real and provide a distinct advantage against the right zombie opponents.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_FUMESHROOM_5: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Fume-tastic! Let's give the zombies a case of the vapours instead!
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_2: {SAY:zombossicon}It is my fervent medical opinion that your humours are out of balance!
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_3: {SAY:zombossicon}Methinks the siphoning of thine brains is the only way to correct this ailment!
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_GARGANTUAR_5: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Hey! I prefer my humors and my brains unbalanced!
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_HYPNOSHROOM_1: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:winnie}Data suggests the Dark Ages were a time of intellectual decline and moral  confusion.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_HYPNOSHROOM_2: {PLAYFUL:winnie}Perhaps now is a good time to call upon the persuasive powers of the Hypno-shroom?
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_HYPNOSHROOM_3: {EXCITED:crazydave}Good idea, Penny! We'll convert the wicked – Dark Ages style!
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_HYPNOSHROOM_4: {SAY:crazydave}Deploy this shroom and the zombies won't know what bit them...
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_HYPNOSHROOM_5: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Until they see that it was their fellow zombies! Then, mind BLOWN!
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_MAGNETSHROOM_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}According to my data, iron and other metals were routinely put to use during the Dark Ages.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_MAGNETSHROOM_2: {EXCITED:winnie}Thus, Magnet-shroom should make an excellent ally here.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_MAGNETSHROOM_3: {EXCITED:crazydave}He can pull buckets, helmets and other metal objects off of zombies!
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_MAGNETSHROOM_4: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Some people think it's magic. But really, it's just physics.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_PEANUT_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Boy, Pea-shooter and Wall-nut sure are good at what they do.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_PEANUT_2: {EXCITED:crazydave}Talk about two great plants that fight great together!
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_PEANUT_3: {EXCITED:winnie}User Dave! Perhaps you are not as cerebrally unsound as you periodically insist!
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_PEANUT_4: {PLAYFUL:winnie}What if there was one plant that behaved like both a Pea-shooter AND a Wall-nut?
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_PEANUT_6: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Two plant powers in one legume's body?
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_PEANUT_7: {EXCITED:crazydave}Keep talkin' like that and people are going to call you Crazy Penny!
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_PEANUT_8: {SAY:crazydave}Which would be weird for both of us.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_1: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY}A question for you, my Ignoble Foes!
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_2: {SAY:zombossicon}Hast thou noted how violent thine plants become upon consuming Plant Food?
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_3: {SAY:zombossicon}Perchance, hast thou wondered what Plant Food is truly made of?
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_4: {SAY:zombossicon}Verily, I shall tell thee. It's zombies! Plant food is made out of zombies!
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_5: {NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Unpossible! We feed our plants only the highest quality organic uhm...
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_6: {TIRED:crazydave}Hey Penny, what is Plant Food made of?
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_7: {SAY:winnie}I fear the true nature of Plant Food requires further analysis, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_DARK_INTRO_ZOMBOSS_8: {TIRED:winnie}Excuse me while I run some tests.
NARRATIVE_DARK_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Why would anyone go and stick a nice sword into a dirty ol' rock?
NARRATIVE_DARK_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_2: {TIRED:winnie}I understand it to be a test, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_DARK_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_3: {EXCITED:winnie}Only someone with great physical strength and strength of character may remove it.
NARRATIVE_DARK_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_4: {SAY:crazydave}I bet someone with a jackhammer could remove it.
NARRATIVE_DARK_OUTRO_DANGER_ROOM_KEY_6: {TIRED:winnie}An inelegant but no doubt effective solution to the test, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_DARK_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}I have found no evidence that Plant Food contains zombies or zombie byproducts.
NARRATIVE_DARK_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_2: {TIRED:crazydave}Phew! Plants shouldn't eat zombies who eat plants.
NARRATIVE_DARK_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_3: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Except Chomper. He has to. Dude needs the fiber.
NARRATIVE_DARK_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_4: {NPC_EXIT:crazydave}{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Why dost thine time-traveling jalopy lie to thee?
NARRATIVE_DARK_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_5: {SAY:zombossicon}Perchance, a question best left for another day?
NARRATIVE_DARK_OUTRO_ZOMBOSS_6: {SAY:zombossicon}Now, I pray, imagine maniacal laughter as I depart.
NARRATIVE_DARK_ZOMBIENOTE_1: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY:winnieicon}User Dave, we have encountered a scroll.
NARRATIVE_DARK_ZOMBIENOTE_2: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{EXCITED:crazydaveicon}I love side-scrollers! They're my second favorite kind of game.
NARRATIVE_DARK_ZOMBIENOTE_3: {SAY:winnieicon}This is not a game. It's a piece of parchment bearing a message.
NARRATIVE_DARK_ZOMBIENOTE_4: {PLAYFUL:crazydaveicon}Will ya look at that! It's Dark Ages email. Neat-o!
NARRATIVE_DARTICHOKE_EQ_1: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Dartichokes aim first at high-priority targets like Wizards and Octo Zombies.
NARRATIVE_DINO_15_OUTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}A meteorite. Curious. My records indicate this should be... bigger.
NARRATIVE_DINO_15_OUTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}More like super Seattle-sized. I hope history has not gone awry...
NARRATIVE_DINO_16_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Surrender your brains forthwith, inane time stumblers!
NARRATIVE_DINO_16_INTRO_2: {SAY:zombossicon}Else you shall share the fate of these terrible thunder lizards: EXTINCTION!
NARRATIVE_DINO_16_INTRO_3: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED:crazydave}But I don't want to get extincted!
NARRATIVE_DINO_17_INTRO_3: {EXCITED:crazydave}I just always wanted a primitive sunflower who gave big suns!

NARRATIVE_DINO_1_INTRO_2: {EXCITED:crazydave}Yabbers! That's before I was even born!
NARRATIVE_DINO_1_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}Correct. We seem to have landed in some form of Jurassic Marsh.

NARRATIVE_DINO_21_INTRO_3: {EXCITED:crazydave}Zuh? But how? Even Gargantuars get knocked back!
NARRATIVE_DINO_21_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}True, User Dave. The Bully is simply too stupid to observe typical physics.

NARRATIVE_DINO_23_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}Their prepaleolithic potency will far exceed our more refined modern versions.
NARRATIVE_DINO_2_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}This epoch is known for its unusual lifeforms, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_DINO_2_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}I was thinking more in terms of saurians, User Dave. Dinosaurs.
NARRATIVE_DINO_2_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}They won't attack us directly and we can't affect them.
NARRATIVE_DINO_2_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}However, they will definitely react to zombies. Be wary!
NARRATIVE_DINO_33_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Well color me bedazzled! Them dinosaurs are still up and about!
NARRATIVE_DINO_33_INTRO_10: {SAY:crazydave}If you mean those green rectangular thingies that hold memory...
NARRATIVE_DINO_33_INTRO_11: {SAY:crazydave}...then I, uh, have no idea what you're talking about.
NARRATIVE_DINO_33_INTRO_13: {SAY:winnie}Either way, if your neighbor hasn't experienced the mania of Modern Day, we are out of the correct time loop.
NARRATIVE_DINO_33_INTRO_16: {EXCITED:crazydave}Spoiler alert: the dinosaurs will be reincarnated as kangaroos!
NARRATIVE_DINO_33_INTRO_19: {SAY:winnie}The black goo on our lawn is tar, a very sticky substance.
NARRATIVE_DINO_33_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}Our temporary leave has not altered that circumstance.
NARRATIVE_DINO_33_INTRO_20: {SAY:winnie}I calculate that zombies will be considerably slower in it.
NARRATIVE_DINO_33_INTRO_21: {TIRED:winnie}Our plants could get sticky as well unfortunately. Enough to prevent them from attacking.
NARRATIVE_DINO_33_INTRO_22: {SAY:crazydave}There's a rumor going around that nuts don't mind being sticky.
NARRATIVE_DINO_33_INTRO_23: {TIRED:crazydave}I'm not sure what to think of that.
NARRATIVE_DINO_33_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}It seems, however, that the ground has changed, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_DINO_33_INTRO_7: {TIRED:winnie}You haven't tampered with my memory cards again, have you User Dave?
NARRATIVE_DINO_35_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}There is some urgent information I must alert you of, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_DINO_35_INTRO_12: {PLAYFUL:winnie}One can make the assumption that Zomboss is running out of plants to bait us with.
NARRATIVE_DINO_35_INTRO_13: {EXCITED:winnie}Either way, Hot Date must be rescued!
NARRATIVE_DINO_35_INTRO_14: {SAY:winnie}With his unique attractive properties, but admittedly low toughness...
NARRATIVE_DINO_35_INTRO_15: {EXCITED:winnie}...he'll make for an excellent bait for the zombies!
NARRATIVE_DINO_35_INTRO_16: {SAY:winnie}Data suggests that tar mostly negates his attractive capabilities.
NARRATIVE_DINO_35_INTRO_17: {SAY:winnie}Luckily: his spice will destroy whatever zombie digested him.
NARRATIVE_DINO_35_INTRO_18: {SAY:winnie}Additionally, he will spread a lane of fire that will damage zombies below their armor once destroyed.
NARRATIVE_DINO_35_INTRO_2: {EXCITED:winnie}We have reached the first plant that Zomboss had trapped in this time period.
NARRATIVE_DINO_35_INTRO_20: {SAY:winnie}It will be best to use him in order to bait zombies out of lanes with dinosaurs and straight into tar.
NARRATIVE_DINO_35_INTRO_21: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Nothing like some good ol' push n' stickin!
NARRATIVE_DINO_35_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}It has weird "timey wimey", I believe is the scientific terminology, stuff around it.
NARRATIVE_DINO_35_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}It appears to be surrounded by radiation that Zomboss' latest experiments have shared.
NARRATIVE_DINO_35_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}Whatever it is, it's tied to what Zomboss has in store down the line.
NARRATIVE_DINO_35_INTRO_9: {EXCITED:winnie}This plant appears to be Hot Date! Normally, a festive plant.
NARRATIVE_DINO_36_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Warning: The Jurassic period was not a safe environment for organization.
NARRATIVE_DINO_36_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}Frequent migrations of different species caused havoc everywhere they passed.
NARRATIVE_DINO_36_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}Scanners show such migrations are on their way right here.
NARRATIVE_DINO_37_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Hey Penny, have you noticed the zombies doing any suspicious activities lately?
NARRATIVE_DINO_37_INTRO_10: {TIRED:winnie}Unfortunately, that might just be enough for the dinos to confuse them for their own.
NARRATIVE_DINO_37_INTRO_11: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}What if I disguised myself as a zombie?
NARRATIVE_DINO_37_INTRO_12: {SAY:crazydave}Would they leave me alone in my tar tub?
NARRATIVE_DINO_37_INTRO_2: {PLAYFUL:winnie}The zombies are usually known for their cunning, but this time period seems devoid of such intelligence.
NARRATIVE_DINO_37_INTRO_3: {EXCITED:crazydave}Leather seems to be all the rage around here!
NARRATIVE_DINO_37_INTRO_6: {EXCITED:winnie}User Dave, we have an impostor here.
NARRATIVE_DINO_37_INTRO_7: {EXCITED:crazydave}I knew it! I can't even take a tar bath without having to watch my back!
NARRATIVE_DINO_37_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}There seem to be zombies that have attempted crafting disguises using primitive tools.
NARRATIVE_DINO_40_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}You know, I usually do not reveal myself this early for you snollygosters.
NARRATIVE_DINO_40_INTRO_2: {SAY:zombossicon}However, I must stress that your futile attempts at hindering my experiments are no longer insignificant to me!
NARRATIVE_DINO_40_INTRO_3: {SAY:zombossicon}Unless I can continue to try and twist time to my desire at peace, I shall not get my well-deserved reward!
NARRATIVE_DINO_40_INTRO_4: {EXCITED:winnie}These brains are items that you shall never have possession of, Zomboss!
NARRATIVE_DINO_40_INTRO_5: {SAY:zombossicon}Oh, please! Your brains have been of secondary concern all along!
NARRATIVE_DINO_40_INTRO_6: {SAY:zombossicon}What I've got in store is something much more up my alley!
NARRATIVE_DINO_40_INTRO_7: {SAY:zombossicon}And the captured plants are something which I will keep for myself!
NARRATIVE_DINO_40_INTRO_8: {SAY:zombossicon}Heed this warning, leave them be and leave me alone!
